svg.title: Radio buttons anatomy
svg.desc: Figma Button group artwork exported through the Figma MCP from WARP Components, node 7631:5013 (FINN, light). Source: https://www.figma.com/design/oHBCzDdJxHQ6fmFLYWUltf/WARP---Components?node-id=7631-5013. Original component paths are unchanged. The gray backdrop and three red numbered callouts were composed locally, using the callout artwork from the existing Radio and Alert anatomy illustrations. 1: Selected option. 2: Option label. 3: Group container.
